subject: Post-demo: decision criteria and procurement timeline for GreenLane
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Mira Patel <mira@greenlanehealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T17:10:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: decision criteria and procurement timeline for GreenLane

Thanks again for your time today, Mira — great discussion. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can align internal owners and timeline:

1) Decision criteria summary we heard from the call:
   - Latency: p95 inference target ~<= 250 ms for typical user flows (medical triage)
   - Cost: target unit economics that keep per-API-call cost competitive vs current vendor (please flag if you need a specific $/token or $/call target)
   - Deployment preference: private VPC preferred for PHI-sensitive flows; Hosted API with dedicated capacity acceptable for initial pilot
   - SLOs: 99.9% uptime target, clear P95/P99 SLA and escalation windows

2) Stakeholder mapping (please correct):
   - Economic buyer: Anil Kapoor (CTO) — decision authority for budget
   - Procurement: procurement@greenlanehealth.com / Carlos Jimenez (procurement lead)
   - Security/Compliance: Mira (you) coordinating SOC2, data residency & KMS requirements

3) Next steps I propose:
   - We’ll attach a first-pass Mutual Action Plan and an SLA draft (attached).
   - Can you confirm the procurement contact and whether GreenLane requires a PO, EULA-only, or master services agreement?
   - If an on-prem or VPC deployment is required for pilot, share rough timing constraints (target start date).

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-greenlane.xlsx (MAP), Redwood-SLA-draft-v1.pdf

If the items above look right I’ll loop in Aditya and Lauren to own pricing and contract touchpoints. Would you be able to confirm procurement contact and whether Anil wants to be in an executive-level call next week?

Best,
SoJin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Note: MAP includes proposed milestones (pilot -> evaluation -> production) and an initial cost range for hosted vs dedicated flows.

From: Mira Patel <mira@greenlanehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Anil Kapoor <anil.kapoor@greenlanehealth.com>, Carlos Jimenez <carlos.j@greenlanehealth.com>, procurement@greenlanehealth.com
Date: 2026-12-02T20:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: decision criteria and procurement timeline for GreenLane

Thanks, Soojin — good summary. A few clarifications:

- Confirmed: Anil (CTO) is the economic approver. He’ll want a short exec summary and an estimate of run-rate cost for a 6-month pilot (approx 100k monthly inference calls).
- Procurement contact is procurement@greenlanehealth.com; Carlos is the day-to-day. They typically prefer a PO + Master Services Agreement.
- Security: I’ll route your SOC2 and KMS questions to our security manager; for now we expect encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys (KMS) and audit logs.
- Deployment: for pilot we’re open to Redwood Hosted with a dedicated pool, but RAMP to VPC/on-prem is possible for production.

I’ve uploaded the internal tech/contact details to the shared drive link you provided. Please send an updated MAP with milestones and a pilot cost estimate. Also send the SLA draft to the procurement address so Carlos can start an internal checklist.

-Mira
Director, Security & Product Compliance
GreenLane Health
mira@greenlanehealth.com

Subject: RE: Post-demo: decision criteria and procurement timeline for GreenLane

Looping in pricing and deployment options — quick notes for the MAP update:

- Pilot sizing: if Mira’s estimate is ~100k calls/month, we should present two options:
  1) Hosted Dedicated pool: predictable latency, faster onboarding. Recommend p95 target <= 250 ms; ballpark pilot cost = $18k–$28k/month depending on batching and KV cache assumptions.
  2) Private VPC (managed): higher setup/one-time infra, better control for KMS and audit logs. Pilot TCO higher but preferred for PHI long-term.

- SLA: we can offer 99.9% platform uptime for Dedicated with a P95/P99 latency SLA baked into the contract; need legal to scope credits. Lauren, can you draft an SLA section that includes latency targets and an escalation path? I’ll prepare the cost worksheet and update the MAP.

Attachments: Redwood-SLA-draft-v1.pdf (first-pass), mutual-action-plan-greenlane.xlsx

-Aditya
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: procurement@greenlanehealth.com, Carlos Jimenez <carlos.j@greenlanehealth.com>, Mira Patel <mira@greenlanehealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-04T16:20:00Z
Subject: RE: Post-demo: decision criteria and procurement timeline for GreenLane

Hi all — thanks for the intro, Mira. I’m the attorney supporting this engagement; quick next steps from legal: 

1) I’ve attached a short SLA addendum we can start from (Redwood-SLA-draft-v1.pdf). It includes proposed latency targets (p95 <= 250 ms), uptime objective (99.9%), and remedies for SLA failures. Happy to walk through specifics with Carlos.
2) Procurement: if GreenLane requires a PO + MSA, our standard process is to review the procurement questionnaire, accept limited redlines, and then ship for signature. We use DocuSign for e-signature.
3) Security/compliance: we can provide SOC2 Type II report and a KMS integration playbook; we’ll need to confirm key rotation responsibilities in the MAP.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Soojin/Aditya: send the updated MAP with the two pilot options and the 6-month cost estimate for Anil.
- Carlos / procurement@greenlanehealth.com: please confirm the preferred contract vehicle (PO + MSA vs. enterprise purchase order) and any mandatory vendor requirements (insurance limits, indemnity caps).
- I’ll open a redline thread once procurement shares their standard MSA; alternatively you can start with our MSA and tag any mandatory clauses.

DocuSign link for initial SLA addendum (preview): https://www.docusign.com/link/to/sla-redline

Thanks — I’ll be available for a 30-min call tomorrow if Carlos or Anil wants to walk the SLA.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0167
